page: Microsoft Azure EC64as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECasv6 server family. Powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The virtualization layer is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include any onboard GPUs or local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external volumes. It is, however, Premium Storage capable, allowing high-performance external disk attachments to offset the lack of local NVMe drives. The absence of hardware accelerators makes it unsuitable for GPU-bound workloads like deep learning training or real-time graphics rendering.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC64as_v6 offers a high-density memory configuration relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-intensive applications without the overhead of paying for unneeded GPU hardware. This profile is well-suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and data analytics pipelines that require substantial memory capacity to process large datasets.
